judgment.rationale: The issue is assigned and linked to the active upstream PR for multiple Peek CLI argument-handling fixes, so it should remain outside the new design queue.

judgment.recommended_action: Track PR #49724 instead of drafting another design for this already owned Peek CLI issue.
